3110947.findings: Kamikoto cleaver (nakiri/chuka style) with black handle, steel bolster, Damascus-pattern etched blade, in branded ash box with Certificate of Authenticity and product card. 3110947.condition: Appears unused or lightly used, box and paperwork present, no visible damage.

3110947.marks_read: kamikoto logo on box lid and blade; certificate of authenticity

3111019.reason: Decorative green glass bowl, uranium unconfirmed, modest value.

3111073.findings: Colourful whimsical cats and flowers with white resist lines, signed lower right 'Evelyn Antonysen'. 3111073.condition: Frame good, no visible foxing or damage through the glass.
3111073.reason: Signed Evelyn Antonysen cat picture, collectable Tasmanian artist with local demand.

3111130.findings: Taxidermy rock ptarmigan in white winter plumage with red eye combs (male), mounted on a natural branch base. Good quality mount. Overseas game bird, not a protected Australian species.
3111130.condition: Plumage clean, some feathers slightly ruffled at the tail and breast; no obvious losses.
3111130.reason: Decent quality taxidermy game bird mount, decorator demand.
